title: Sports aerodynamics: conventional and reverse swing of a cricket ball
status: reviewed and locally validated; passes 1-9 complete; gate 6b passed round 2 (0 blocking)
transcript_provenance: Publisher-uploaded English captions (NPTEL YouTube channel, non-automatic track)
source_uncertainties: The publisher caption title card reads Week 12 Lecture 40; the playlist/manifest label is Lecture 33. Timestamps use L33.
All six contact sheets s01-s06 were scanned and the listed 20 fullframes actually viewed. f0099 shows the lecturer, not a slide; it supplies no numerical claim.
All 40 original videos were deliberately deleted before this assignment. No playback or recovery was attempted or claimed; retained captions and images supply the recording evidence.
Slide f0005 uses Re=rho V D/mu, Cd=2Fd/(rho V^2 A). Lateral force is Cz in f0070/f0092. The chapter uses C_Y and lateral y, vertical z, with an explicit translation.
The slide seam-angle symbol phi_T (f0070/f0090) is translated to theta_s so phi remains the book velocity potential. S/N names are local and tied to incoming flow and leading seam.

The early lecture two-state turbulence explanation is qualified by its own later delayed-laminar result at 2734-2752 s, checked in f0090/f0092 and Parekh 2024. Initial conventional swing does not prove turbulence on the seam side.

Source-specific regimes differ: Parekh 2024 is a five-trip 30 degree model over Re 5e4-4.5e5; Shah 2023 is a 71 mm actual new specimen over Re .45e5-3.40e5. Neither is a universal calibration of the constructed case.
Shah 2023 says near 1.7e5 in E16-6 and greater than 1.8e5 in E16-7 for its 30 degree reversal. The chapter reports the approximate 1.7-1.8e5 interval, not a falsely exact threshold.

The lecture weather slide f0094 has illustrative viscosities and Reynolds numbers not exactly consistent with one fixed diameter; the chapter instead recomputes hypothetical input sensitivity without attributing exact properties to named grounds.

Humidity effect is treated as requiring a state/property model; no precise humid-air law or quantitative humidity claim is asserted. Vortex condensation/cavitation and batter-ear acoustic statements are not repeated as findings.
Sports fatigue/world-record claims, current manufacturer/product judgments, rules and equipment regulations are omitted as outside the supported fluid-mechanics scope.

Deshpande 2018: only the publisher abstract was accessible and consulted for qualitative roughness-ordering evidence; no full-paper pages, detailed roughness values, or precise speed thresholds are claimed.
The constructed density 1.20 kg/m3 is an assumption. nu=1.562e-5 m2/s at 25 C is taken from Shah 2023 E16-3. Their combination is not advertised as a measured thermodynamic state.

The 2023 knuckleball result is a horizontal quasi-steady estimated trajectory criterion, not experimentally established dismissal probability; force reversal and lateral-motion reversal are distinguished.

The chapter implements a prescribed-force trajectory model, not CFD; figures are computed analytic trajectories and an original geometry schematic. Browser validation and independent scientific acceptance remain pending.

symbol_ledger.definition: Flight/lateral/vertical coordinates (m), time(s), ball velocity components and relative airspeed(m/s), constructed flight length(m).
Mass kg, diameter m, frontal area m2, density kg/m3, kinematic/dynamic viscosity m2/s and Pa s, dynamic pressure Pa, signed lateral force N and coefficient.
Local wall tangent/normal distances and tangential velocity; signed wall shear Pa; drag magnitude N and coefficient; Reynolds number based on U and D.
Seam and roughness height m, seam angle, dimensionless incoming turbulence intensity, angular speed rad/s, unknown dependency function.
Leading seam and non-seam sides under explicit top view; source seam angle translated to theta_s; source lateral z translated to y.
Ball surface, outward solid normal, patch area, pressure, viscous air-on-solid traction, far-field pressure and pressure coefficient.
Constructed constant hemisphere pressures and their pressure coefficients.
Hypothetical kinematic viscosities; local air-velocity field V_a in m/s, distinct from ball velocity; air vorticity curl V_a in 1/s, distinct from ball angular speed.
Flight time s, endpoint lateral displacement m, prescribed coefficient amplitude, gravity 9.81 m/s2.
Number of full ball rotations in flight (source N); distinct from side N.
Ball radius, polar/azimuthal projection angles, piecewise constant force magnitude.
